row.expected_behavior: Completion warns about remaining quantity and pending dispatch.

common_setup: Created a disposable QA owner/factory through the local browser runtime.
Completed onboarding for order-based production, one Rapier loom, one meter worker, payroll setup, and trial start.
Configured estimator baseline in the local runtime.
Created disposable active orders through Estimator -> accepted Quote -> Create active order.
Linked the disposable loom and worker assignments through the Machines UI when production logs were needed.
Used only http://localhost:3000 against the QA runtime.
scenario_a_below_target_warning: Created Scenario A order with target 100m.
Opened the order detail drawer at 0m / 100m.
Observed completion confirmation before status changed.
Observed the order leave active orders only after explicit confirmation.
scenario_b_pending_dispatch_warning: Created Scenario B proof order with target 30m.
Linked Rapier 1 to the order and logged 20m production through the supervisor dashboard.
Opened Stock and used the order-linked 20m lot.
Saved a stock sale only, leaving 20m sold pending dispatch.
Returned to the order and clicked Mark Complete.
Observed completion confirmation containing both remaining quantity and pending dispatch warnings before status changed.
Observed the order leave active orders only after explicit confirmation.
scenario_c_normal_completion: Created Scenario C order with target 10m and no stock sale.
Linked Rapier 1 to the order and saved a 9.99m production log through the supervisor dashboard edit window.
Opened the order detail drawer showing 9.99m / 10m, no pending dispatch, and Mark Complete available.
Observed no completion warning dialog and the order completed normally.

scenario_a.dialog_evidence_sanitized: Complete order dialog rendered with remaining quantity: 100 m remains from a 100 m target; Keep Active and Complete Anyway buttons were present.

scenario_b.dialog_evidence_sanitized: Complete order dialog rendered with remaining quantity: 10 m remains from a 30 m target, and pending dispatch: 20 m still pending dispatch; Keep Active and Complete Anyway buttons were present.

scenario_c.completion_guard_tolerance_note: The order completion guard treats produced_meters + 0.01 < target_meters as below target; 9.99m against 10m did not trigger below-target confirmation.

pass_ready_decision.reason: Browser/runtime proof covers below-target confirmation, pending-dispatch confirmation, and no-warning normal completion in the disposable QA runtime.
